title: Trump claims US will end military aid to Israel by end of this year
paragraphs: Donald Trump has said that the US will end military aid to Israel at the end of this year in a surprise election day announcement that appeared to be targeted at voters sceptical of US support for Israel and the war in Gaza.
In a phone interview with Fox News as voting began on Tuesday morning, the US president said the US would cut nearly $4bn (£2.96bn) in military aid to Israel because “they don’t need it”.
“We were giving them $4bn … But it gets cut off at the end of the year,” he said.
